description: Detect deforestation from Sentinel-1 and aggregate forest-change KPIs by Uganda ADM-4 administrative unit. 1. Construct a 2020 natural-forest baseline. 2. Process Sentinel-1 backscatter and fit a logistic curve per pixel. 3. Detect the decimal year of deforestation. 4. Sum forest-stock, annual forest-loss, and forest-loss-to-cropland areas (ha) over ADM-4 geometries. The returned vector cube contains those KPIs per administrative unit.

returns.description: A vector cube, with columns (bands) for each KPI

parameters.name: spatial_extent
parameters.description:
Limits the data to process to the specified bounding box or polygons.

For raster data, the process loads the pixel into the data cube if the point
at the pixel center intersects with the bounding box or any of the polygons
(as defined in the Simple Features standard by the OGC).

For vector data, the process loads the geometry into the data cube if the geometry
is fully within the bounding box or any of the polygons (as defined in the
Simple Features standard by the OGC). Empty geometries may only be in the
data cube if no spatial extent has been provided.

Empty geometries are ignored.

Set this parameter to null to set no limit for the spatial extent.

base.description: Base (optional, lower left corner, coordinate axis 3).

height.description: Height (optional, upper right corner, coordinate axis 3).

crs.description: Coordinate reference system of the extent, specified as as [EPSG code](http://www.epsg-registry.org/) or [WKT2 CRS string](http://docs.opengeospatial.org/is/18-010r7/18-010r7.html). Defaults to `4326` (EPSG code 4326) unless the client explicitly requests a different coordinate reference system.

schema.title: Vector data cube
schema.description: Limits the data cube to the bounding box of the given geometries in the vector data cube. For raster data, all pixels inside the bounding box that do not intersect with any of the polygons will be set to no data (`null`). Empty geometries are ignored.

schema.title: No filter
schema.description: Don't filter spatially. All data is included in the data cube.

parameters.name: canopy_cover_threshold
parameters.description: Minimum canopy cover to be considered forest. Units: percent. Should be one of (10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90). A value of 30 implies > 30% canopy cover.

parameters.name: natural_forest_threshold
parameters.description: Minimum likelihood to be considered natural forest. Units: fraction. A value of 0.08 implies > 8% likelihood.

parameters.name: min_connected_area
parameters.description: Minimum connected area to be considered forest. Units: m^2

parameters.name: orbit_state
parameters.description: The orbit state to process (ascending, descending)

parameters.name: speckle_filter_radius
parameters.description: The radius of the speckle filter. Units: pixels

parameters.name: speckle_filter_cv_noise
parameters.description: The coefficient of variation of the speckle noise. In multi-looked data, this takes the value of 1 / sqrt(ENL), where ENL is the Equivalent Number of Looks.

parameters.name: speckle_filter_temporal_window
parameters.description: The temporal window of the speckle filter. Units: pixels

parameters.name: spatial_resolution
description: The spatial resolution to process. Units: meters.
Data are resampled to this resolution.

parameters.name: logistic_window_size
parameters.description: The window size (number of observations) of the logistic curve fit

parameters.name: logistic_steepness_parameter
parameters.description: The steepness parameter of the logistic curve fit. Units: dimensionless

parameters.name: temporal_variability_threshold
parameters.description: Exclude any pixels with temporal standard deviation below this threshold. Units: dB

parameters.name: flattening_threshold
parameters.description: Exclude any pixels with flattening below this threshold. Units: dimensionless

parameters.name: logistic_sse_threshold
parameters.description: Exclude any pixels with Sum of Squared Errors (SSE) above this threshold. Units: dB^2

parameters.name: cropland_probability_threshold
parameters.description: Threshold for cropland probability, above which a pixel is considered cropland. Units: fraction
